question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

The scent of freshly baked bread filled the bakery, __________ (sickening) customers to step inside.
solution:
The correct answer is: **enticing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sickening"** refers to something that causes disgust, nausea, or an unpleasant sensation. (घृणित, मतली पैदा करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The sight of spoiled food was sickening to look at.
 
 
 
• **"Enticing"** refers to something that attracts or tempts someone, making them want to engage or indulge in it. (लुभावना)
 
 
• **Example: **The aroma of freshly brewed coffee was so enticing that I couldn't resist ordering a cup.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sickening' **is **'enticing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **enticing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wakening** (जगाना): The act of waking up or causing someone to wake up.

 
 
• **Example:** The loud noise in the street was wakening everyone in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• **Withdrawing** (वापस लेना): To retreat or remove oneself from a situation or place.
 
 
• **Example:** She began withdrawing from social events after her promotion.
 
 
 
• **Pampering** (लाड़-प्यार करना): To indulge or treat someone with excessive care or attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The spa offers pampering treatments for ultimate relaxation.
